description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that manages account handling features such as adding, removing, renaming accounts, setting account visibility for app packages, and enabling/disabling components. It also includes UI logic for user interactions and app info retrieval.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling account management and user interface interactions for the authentication app.

methods.name: isAccountAdded
methods.description: Checks if a given account of the specific type has already been added.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets UI components, and defines button click behaviors for account operations.
